'''Tahnchukka''', nicknamed '''Tank''', was a one-eyed [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who was the companion of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Crovan Dane]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he and Dane aided the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Cyberneticist/Legends|cyberneticist]] [[Bitt Panith]] by capturing a list of animals in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]]<ref name="destiny" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] for the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], so that he could create [[Krossen]], a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] capable of resisting [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="destiny" />
{{RPG}}
Their efforts were, however, jeopardized by the [[Bant Eerin's Padawan|Padawan]] of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]] and a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], [[Jaylen Kos]]. The pair talked to the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Zaboshka]], who claimed to have had knowledge about the whereabouts of Dane. In exchange for money, the technician led the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to a cantina, where the [[Changeling/Legends|changeling]] [[Goomi]] was residing.<ref name="destiny" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
To date, Tahnchukka has only appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi]]'', a [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny|''Decide Your Destiny'']] novel by [[Jake Forbes]] and [[Sue Behrent]]. Given that the book is a ''Decide Your Destiny''' role-playing adventure, Tahnchukka can appear in several possible story strands, and his actions are influenced by the reader's decisions. This article details the version in which he is featured for the longest time.

They, however, could not deliver the cargo due to the intervention of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin's]] [[Bant Eerin's Padawan|Padawan]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] [[Jaylen Kos]] and [[Sunchoo]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] Wookiee. Sunchoo distracted the two criminals, while the two Jedi released the beasts incarcerated in cages aboard Dane's [[Crovan Dane's starship|starship]]. One of the beasts, a [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]], [[Death/Legends|killed]] Dane and chased Tahnchukka into the forest.
